message: <g role="option"> stands under <a> with no role and a way to land on it
$reason: An option under a link inside a map: an `<a href>` in an `<svg>`, which the parser names `:svg:a` and Angular draws as an SVG `<a>` with its address — a link Chromium focuses, and axe gives it the role `link` and holds it focusable (measured: Angular 22.2, Chromium 153, axe 4.13, which reports the option). A link may not stand between an option and its listbox. Point 9's table gives an `<a>` no role, axe working it out from the address, so the gate refuses it as an element with no role and a way to land on it, as it refuses the same `<a href>` outside the map. The walk asked axe about the raw name, `:svg:a`, a tag it does not know, and passed the option; it asks about the local name the tag scan reads now, which the message names.
